summary: Confirmations are asked before sign-in or any request, and a refused or impossible confirmation now exits 2 (it exited 1). Without a terminal these commands now need --yes: axiom secrets activate, revoke, rewrap, destroy, revoke-grant, disable-workload, update-environment, and bind when it updates an existing binding (a non-zero expected_revision); the new axiom secrets rotate, axiom project resources revoke, axiom auth disable, axiom auth mfa set when it changes the policy, factors or step-up window, axiom project environments reset and delete, axiom workspace members remove and invitations cancel, the axiom data write, saved-query and capture commands, the axiom intel commands that change settings, pull requests or ingestion sources, and the axiom auth removals and deletions (providers remove, users delete and remove-factor, trusted-issuers remove, roles delete, permissions delete, assignments remove, organizations remove-member and suspending an organization or member, invitations revoke, email unsuppress, smtp remove, templates reset). axiom auth oauth-apps delete needs --confirm "delete client ID". axiom auth users reset-factors, revoke-consent and revoke, webhooks delete, hooks remove and sms remove already needed --yes and now refuse before signing in.
migration: In CI and other scripts without a terminal, review each listed command and pass --yes (or the typed --confirm phrase) where the change is intended. Treat exit status 2 as a refused confirmation or usage error; nothing was sent to Axiom Cloud.
